researchTarget: preceding Deep Runner output + unresolved Chief directives + Alpha/Beta peer requests
researchQuestion: Which preceding-shift findings are ready for Chief review, which still require corroboration or quarantine, and what should the next Deep Runner shift investigate without duplicating the six required lanes?
summary: Adaptation handoff only; no broad new research launched. The preceding Deep Runner AV-certification falsification is high-confidence, non-duplicative auxiliary work and is ready for Chief review in narrowed form. It materially strengthens the structural-causal lane by showing that federal certification is a real but migrating, architecture-specific transition constraint rather than a permanent generic regulatory moat. The source chain is substantially shared with the structural-causal lane, so the finding should be treated as corroborative/falsification depth, not as an independent new evidence family. The remaining high-value unresolved work is (1) XTND capitalization/runway reconstruction, which still blocks admission/scoring, (2) exact-machine-SHA CI proof, which remains a hard integrity blocker for approval, and (3) company-level autonomy architecture classification plus measured certification latency before applying the AV constraint to individual active-universe names. No canonical state is changed by this artifact.

findings.finding: The preceding Deep Runner artifact and the same-cycle structural-causal lane converge on the same primary NHTSA facts: Cybercab self-certification remains auditable after deployment; Zoox used an exemption pathway; NHTSA is simultaneously streamlining Part 555 and rewriting AV-specific FMVSS. This supports a distinct federal certification/validation-throughput mechanism while directly falsifying any claim that the mechanism is necessarily permanent or uniformly binding across all AV architectures.

The Deep Runner AV result should not be counted as a separate independent source family from structural-causal because both rely heavily on the same NHTSA/Federal Register origin chain. Its value is independent challenge/falsification and refinement of the causal claim, not multiplicative source independence.

The AV certification directive is analytically ready for Chief review if phrased narrowly: architecture-specific, time-varying certification/validation throughput with explicit falsifiers tied to standards modernization, approval latency and audit/oversight burden. Company-specific score effects are not ready because active-universe architecture/deployment-path classification has not been completed.

XTND remains the highest-value company-specific unresolved research target: same-cycle underwriting still cannot reconcile exact post-close basic/fully diluted shares, pre-funded warrants, earnout dilution and normalized runway. Registration capacity must remain separate from actual issued/economic dilution. Admission, score and per-share opportunity analysis remain blocked.

Exact machine-SHA Earth CI proof remains a separate hard approval blocker. Machine/runtime state is coherent, but the reviewed same-cycle source-integrity adaptation still says the deterministic machine commit lacks qualifying exact-SHA CI proof. Deep Runner should not attempt to reinterpret later supervisor-only commits as machine execution proof.

contradictions.issue: AV regulation is both an active deployment constraint and an active target of deregulatory/standards modernization. A static 'regulation is a durable moat/bottleneck' interpretation is contradicted by the same primary source family that proves present-day certification friction.
contradictions.disposition: Preserve as a migrating constraint with explicit decay/falsifier conditions; do not smooth into a one-directional thesis.

contradictions.issue: Structural-causal has enough evidence to support the mechanism, while underwriting correctly states there is not yet enough company-level architecture classification to apply the mechanism uniformly to active-universe names.
contradictions.disposition: No conflict: mechanism-level confidence can be high while name-specific magnitude remains unknown.

unknowns: No same-cycle dataset yet quantifies post-streamlining Part 555 application-to-decision latency across multiple AV developers.

Active-universe autonomy names have not yet been systematically classified as conventional-control compliant, purpose-built nontraditional-control, exemption-dependent, or software-only for this regulatory mechanism.
State/local operating permits, insurance and municipal authorization remain outside the scope of the preceding Deep Runner artifact and should not be conflated with federal vehicle certification.
XTND exact post-close economic share denominator and normalized runway remain unresolved.
Qualifying exact-machine-SHA CI proof for the current deterministic boundary remains unresolved in reviewed artifacts.
falsifiers: Downgrade the AV certification-throughput mechanism if finalized AV-specific FMVSS permit routine self-certification of purpose-built ADS-only architectures without exemptions, material audit delay or approval friction.
Downgrade materiality if measured certification/exemption latency is consistently short and predictable relative to vehicle development and production lead times.

Strengthen the migrated validation/oversight mechanism if safety-case evidence, audit remediation, exemption volume caps or operational oversight become the binding scaling constraint after legacy manual-control standards are removed.
recommendedActionDetail: Chief may review the AV constraint for narrow mechanism-level promotion only; if promoted, mark the cycle for recompute. Keep name-specific AV impact pending until underwriting architecture classification exists. Keep XTND and exact-SHA CI directives open. Do not infer source-family independence from repeated use of the same NHTSA origin chain.
